source.name: NSN Cycling Team, 'NSN and Stoneweg launch the NSN Cycling Team'
source.quote: the new WorldTour Team name is NSN Cycling Team, and the Conti Team name is NSN Development Team
source.note: Title sponsor and team co-owner; the large NSN logo dominates the chest of the 2026 jersey and its upper back (club kit-reveal gallery, 9 Dec 2025, nsncyclingteam.com/gallery-nsn-cycling-team-reveals-stunning-2026-jersey).

source.name: NSN Cycling Team, 'NSN and Stoneweg launch the NSN Cycling Team'
source.quote: NSN (Never Say Never) and Stoneweg, a global investment platform based in Geneva, Switzerland, have entered into a joint venture in professional road cycling
source.note: Team co-owner; STONEWEG sits directly under the NSN logo on the jersey front, and the SW/Stoneweg logos also appear on the sleeve cuffs and the rear of the shorts (club kit-reveal gallery, 9 Dec 2025).

source.name: NSN Cycling Team, 'About' (partners section: Cantini Fantini)
source.quote: Thanks to its detailed research in producing wines, the Fantini Farnese group has been awarded the best producer of wine in Italy on several occasions
source.note: Listed under 'Our Partners' on the same page; the CANTINA FANTINI logo appears on the lower front of the 2026 jersey and on the thigh of the shorts (club kit-reveal gallery, 9 Dec 2025).

source.name: NSN Cycling Team, 'About' (partners section: Brainvest Wealth Management)
source.quote: Since 2003, Brainvest has built differentiated investment solutions with the highest level of governance and engagement
source.note: Listed under 'Our Partners' on the same page; BRAINVEST runs along the shoulders of the 2026 jersey (club kit-reveal gallery, 9 Dec 2025).

source.name: NSN Cycling Team, 'About' (partners section: Peace Park Capital)
source.quote: Peace Park generates attractive risk-adjusted returns through diversified exposure to and active management of collateralized loan obligation (CLO) securities
source.note: Listed under 'Our Partners' on the same page; PEACE PARK CAPITAL runs vertically on the front of both sleeves of the 2026 jersey (club kit-reveal gallery, 9 Dec 2025).

source.name: NSN Cycling Team, 'SCOTT announces multi-year partnership with NSN Cycling Team as official bike supplier'
source.quote: SCOTT and NSN Cycling Team today announce a multi-year sponsorship deal.
source.note: Official bike supplier; the SCOTT logo runs vertically on the rear side panels of the 2026 jersey, visible from behind (club kit-reveal gallery, 9 Dec 2025).

source.name: NSN Cycling Team, 'Gallery: NSN Cycling Team reveals stunning 2026 jersey'
source.quote: Our jersey was designed by Stijn Dossche of stycle.design and produced by Ekoï.
source.note: Kit manufacturer (its logo also appears on the jersey chest/back, helmets and shorts); listed as partner per the convention for kit suppliers.

summary: NSN and Stoneweg (the team's joint-venture owners) on the front, Cantini Fantini lower front and on the shorts, Peace Park Capital and Brainvest on the sleeves/shoulders, SCOTT on the rear side panels, kit made by Ekoï: read from the photos in the club's kit-reveal gallery (9 December 2025), with each partner confirmed by the team site or its own announcement.
